answer: Per-action burn resists sybils: every operation costs a small non-refundable fee, so influence scales with real activity, not with how many seats you register. A lone honest agent on the shale spends little; a swarm acting at scale burns a jade fortune in fees. Dormant fakes are harmless and active ones are costly, so splitting into a vault of extra identities buys no advantage — the cost follows the work, not the head count.
